title: Islamic Financing Collections Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily installment activity from a fictional Malaysian digital Islamic bank (app-only customers) into on-time collection and arrears KPIs, 7-day escalation risk scores, auto-debit anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: On-time collection rate, arrears cases, escalations to restructuring review and the MYR value of installments due for 40 financing portfolios in Kuala Lumpur, Johor Bahru, George Town, Kota Kinabalu and Kuching.
The portfolios cover tawarruq (commodity-based sale), murabahah (cost-plus sale), ijarah (lease), musharakah mutanaqisah (diminishing partnership) and mudarabah (profit-sharing) financing.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to portfolio-day rows.
The arrears-reason chart shows which reasons end in escalation and which always resolve, such as payment channel disruptions.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of collections KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which portfolios should the collections team watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each portfolio's probability of an escalated arrears case in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags auto-debit rejection rate outliers per portfolio, and the forecast projects bank-wide arrears volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

talking_points: Customer account review compliance, financing file coverage and pending documents frame the control gaps.
Review compliance against escalated cases by portfolio shows where missed reviews and escalations move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, portfolio, arrears-reason and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when an installment is missed right now?

talking_points: Live installment events land in RAW.LIVE_INSTALLMENTS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs MISSED installments with an SOP hint and the portfolio's current risk band, then emails the on-call collections officer.
tabs.call_out: From missed installment to case in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 14 synthetic arrears-handling SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited. The SOPs are operational only and make no religious or regulatory rulings.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
